item.title: Hooked on Books: Bookworms, unite!
item.description: Let’s face facts. We all have our addictions. Maybe yours is shopping. Or college football. Or thrift stores. Or those fabulicious 5&Dime cakes sold every Tuesday at the bakery. For me, it’s books. Give me a book, an actual bound book with pages you can dog-ear, and I’m a goner.

item.title: Tally-Ho fundraiser to benefit Rotary scholarship fund
item.description: The Tally-Ho Restaurant will host its 2026 St. Patrick's Day Fundraiser benefitting the Rotary Club’s scholarship program on Tuesday, March 17, from 5-9 p.m.

item.title: Free groceries given to 300 Dallas County families on Bloody Sunday anniversary
item.description: Goodr and Bristol Myers Squibb hosted a free Pop-Up Grocery Market on Saturday, March 7, at Bloch Park providing 300 Dallas County families with five days of groceries.

item.title: Letter to the Editor: Help keep Renee's legacy of service alive
item.description: As many of you know, I had the honor of serving as a District Governor for Rotary, but my proudest title is Renee’s dad. My daughter, Renee Kelley Wilkerson, was a Selma native and former President of the Rotary Club of Selma.

item.title: Valley Grande hosting inaugural fair this week
item.description: The city of Valley Grande is preparing to host its first Valley Grande Fair. The four-day event kicks off this Wednesday, March 11, offering a traditional carnival experience complete with rides, games and funnel cakes.

item.title: Sewell hosts press conference during Bridge Crossing Jubilee
item.description: On Sunday, March 8, ahead of the 61st commemoration of Bloody Sunday, U.S. Rep. Terri Sewell was joined by several elected officials for a press conference at the historic Tabernacle Baptist Church.

item.title: Why Are Electric Bikes the Choice for the Future?
item.description: Electric bikes, or e-bikes, are a sustainable mode of transportation.

item.title: Foot Soldiers Park’s Cinema Festival to feature 23 films from 7 countries
item.description: Foot Soldiers Park has announced the full schedule for its 2026 Selma Cinema Festival, taking place March 26–29 in downtown Selma.

item.title: STJ welcomes new staff writer Nichlos Cutrell
item.description: The Selma Times-Journal is excited to announce the addition of Nichlos Cutrell to the STJ team as a staff writer. He will primarily focus on sports coverage in Selma and Dallas County, but will also cover news and community events.

item.title: Elbow Injuries From Car Accidents: Why Legal Support Makes a Difference in How These Claims Are Resolved
item.description: Elbow injuries do not make headlines the way spinal cord damage or traumatic brain injuries do, but for the people who suffer them in car accidents, they can be profoundly disruptive.
